title: Polynomial-time equality test
statement: If $f : \{0,1\}^* \to \{0,1\}^*$ is polynomial-time computable, then for every fixed bit word $w$, the function that returns the one-bit word $[1]$ when $f(x)=w$ and $[0]$ otherwise is polynomial-time computable.
replaced: For every polynomial-time computable string function $f$ and fixed word $w$, the single-bit test deciding whether $f$ of the input equals $w$ is polynomial-time computable.
